questions.prompt: How can you create engaging effects for buttons in Unity?
options: By using sprite atlases or sprite sheets for optimization
Through scripting to define custom behaviors
By assigning functions or methods to buttons
Using Unity's animation system or event triggers
questions.explanation: Hiệu ứng sinh động cho nút thường dùng Animation system (Animator) hoặc Event Trigger — sprite atlas chỉ tối ưu hiệu năng, không tạo hiệu ứng.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of a rig when animating a model?
options: To create realistic textures
To determine the model's color palette
To specify which parts of the model can move
To generate environmental effects
questions.explanation: Rig (bộ khung xương) xác định những phần nào của model có thể cử động được.

questions.prompt: How does the principle of Immediate Feedback enhance user experience in UI design?
options: By providing extensive tutorials
By giving users instant responses to their actions
By making the interface visually complex
By maintaining uniformity in design elements
questions.explanation: Immediate Feedback nghĩa là phản hồi NGAY LẬP TỨC cho hành động của người dùng.

questions.prompt: How can you trigger a transition between states using a script?
options: By directly changing the animation clip.
By setting a parameter in the Animator.
By enabling is Transitioning property of the Animator.
By calling Animator.TransitionToState().
questions.explanation: Cách chuẩn để kích hoạt transition bằng script là set parameter (Trigger/Bool/Float/Int) trên Animator — không có API TransitionToState().

questions.prompt: How does the principle of Guidance help users in UI design?
options: By making the interface visually complex within the interface
By providing clear instructions, cues, or assistance within the interface
By allowing users to customize the interface extensively
By focusing solely on aesthetic appeal within the interface
questions.explanation: Guidance là cung cấp hướng dẫn/gợi ý rõ ràng để người dùng biết phải làm gì tiếp theo.

questions.prompt: What is the function of Rigidbody's 'drag' property in Unity?
options: To adjust the gravitational pull on the object.
To simulate air or fluid resistance, affecting how quickly an object slows down when moving through space.
To apply a constant force in a specific direction.
To control the rotational speed of the object.
questions.explanation: 'Drag' mô phỏng lực cản không khí/chất lỏng, làm vật chậm dần khi di chuyển — không liên quan trọng lực (đó là Gravity Scale/Use Gravity).

questions.prompt: Analyze the code: GameObject enters trigger zone tagged "Checkpoint" — checkpointEffect.SetActive(true); Debug.Log("Checkpoint Reached!")
options: The GameObject will change color
A particle effect will be activated and a message logged
The GameObject will stop moving
The GameObject will increase in size
questions.explanation: SetActive(true) kích hoạt object hiệu ứng (checkpointEffect), đồng thời Debug.Log in thông báo ra Console.

questions.prompt: Script attached to GameObject with Rigidbody: rb.AddForce(Vector3.up * 500f) khi nhấn Space — điều gì xảy ra?
options: The GameObject will move downward with a force of 500 Newtons.
The GameObject will rotate around the Y-axis.
The GameObject will move upward with a force of 500 Newtons
The GameObject's velocity will decrease by 500 units per second.
questions.explanation: Vector3.up là hướng +Y (lên trên), AddForce với lực 500 đẩy vật bay lên.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of a Fixed joint in Unity?
options: Simulating a door hinge or swinging pendulum
Applying a spring-like force between connected bodies
Preventing relative motion between connected bodies
Providing customizable constraints for defining complex object relationships and motion
questions.explanation: Fixed Joint 'hàn cứng' hai object lại, ngăn mọi chuyển động tương đối giữa chúng (khác Hinge = bản lề, Spring = lực đàn hồi, Configurable = tùy biến).

questions.prompt: What is the primary role of the Rigidbody component in Unity when creating physics-based puzzles?
options: To add visual effects to objects during collisions
To enable objects to respond to physics simulations, such as gravity and collisions, affecting their movement and rotation.
To define the graphical representation of objects in the game world.
To play audio effects when objects interact with the environment.
questions.explanation: Rigidbody cho phép object chịu tác động của physics engine: trọng lực, va chạm, lực — ảnh hưởng tới di chuyển/xoay.

questions.prompt: Why might you choose to use a component-based design in Unity over an inheritance-based design?
options: Component-based design simplifies debugging and reduces the complexity of your scripts
Component-based design allows for greater flexibility and reusability of GameObject functionalities
Component-based design is more familiar to developers than inheritance-based design from GameObject
Component-based design ensures better performance across different platforms
questions.explanation: Ưu điểm cốt lõi của component-based design là tính linh hoạt và khả năng tái sử dụng chức năng giữa các GameObject khác nhau.

questions.prompt: What is the first step in implementing a data saving and loading system in Unity?
options: Serialization
Data Collection
Storage Management
Loading Process
questions.explanation: Bước đầu tiên là Serialization — chuyển dữ liệu (object/state) thành định dạng có thể lưu trữ được (ví dụ JSON, binary).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a common method to implement player movement in a 2D game?
options: Rigidbody2D with forces
Transform.Translate
Custom C# script for movement
Particle System
questions.explanation: Particle System dùng để tạo hiệu ứng hạt (khói, lửa...), không phải công cụ di chuyển nhân vật.

questions.prompt: Which tool in Unity allows you to set breakpoints, inspect variables, and step through code execution?
options: Console Window
Profiler
Debugger
Remote Debugging
questions.explanation: Debugger (tích hợp qua IDE như Visual Studio/Rider) mới cho phép đặt breakpoint, xem biến, step qua từng dòng code.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of an Animator Controller in Unity?
options: To store animation data for game objects
To create visual effects for animations
To organize animation states and transitions
To manage physics interactions between animated objects
questions.explanation: Animator Controller là sơ đồ trạng thái (state machine) tổ chức các animation state và transition giữa chúng.

questions.prompt: What does the Profiler in Unity provide?
options: Log messages and warnings
Properties and components of game objects
Performance metrics and analysis to identify bottlenecks
Debugging for remote devices
questions.explanation: Profiler cung cấp số liệu hiệu năng (CPU, GPU, Memory...) để tìm điểm nghẽn (bottleneck).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a Unity-specific class used for representing rotations?
options: Vector3
Quaternion
Rigidbody
Transform
questions.explanation: Quaternion là kiểu dữ liệu Unity dùng để biểu diễn phép xoay (rotation), tránh hiện tượng gimbal lock của Euler angles.

questions.prompt: In Unity, what is the primary purpose of the Update function within a MonoBehaviour script?
options: Handling initialization tasks before gameplay
Controlling GameObject actions for each frame during gameplay
Responding to user input during gameplay
Executing actions triggered by collisions
questions.explanation: Update() chạy mỗi frame, dùng để cập nhật hành vi GameObject liên tục trong lúc chơi.

questions.prompt: How does a script operate in Unity compared to a traditional program?
options: Unity runs the script continuously in a loop like a traditional program
Unity intermittently passes control to the script by calling specific event functions
Unity executes the script only once at the start of the game
Unity requires manual updates every frame to run script
questions.explanation: Unity theo mô hình event-driven: engine tự gọi các hàm vòng đời (Awake, Start, Update...) theo đúng thời điểm, script không tự chạy vòng lặp riêng.

questions.prompt: How can mouse input be customized in Unity?
options: By adding Rigidbody components to the mouse
By using the Transform component
By modifying Input Actions to adjust sensitivity
By enabling Sprite Renderer on the mouse pointer
questions.explanation: Với New Input System, tùy biến input chuột thực hiện qua Input Actions (binding, sensitivity, processors).

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of Unity's Input System?
options: To manage the appearance of game objects
To control lighting in the scene
To handle user input from devices, touch, or gestures
To define the physics behavior of objects
questions.explanation: Input System xử lý input từ nhiều loại thiết bị: bàn phím, chuột, cảm ứng, gamepad...

questions.prompt: How would you make the character jump only when the "W" key is pressed once?
options: Use Input.GetKey(KeyCode.W) in FixedUpdate().
Use Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.W) in Update().
Use Input.GetKey(KeyCode.W) in Update().
Use Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.W) in FixedUpdate().
questions.explanation: GetKeyDown chỉ trả true đúng 1 frame khi vừa nhấn phím, và nên đọc input trong Update() (không phải FixedUpdate) để không bỏ lỡ input.

questions.prompt: When adjusting the Transform properties of a GameObject, how does parent-child relationship affect child Transform values if the parent Transform is modified?
options: The Transform values of the child GameObjects are not affected by changes to the parent GameObject.
The Transform values of the child GameObjects automatically update to match the parent GameObject's Transform values.
The Transform values of the child GameObjects change relative to their original values, depending on the modification applied to the parent GameObject.
The Transform values of the child GameObjects reset to (0, 0, 0) regardless of the parent GameObject's Transform modifications.
questions.explanation: ⚠️ Câu này khá mơ hồ về wording — local Transform của con giữ nguyên, nhưng vị trí/xoay THẾ GIỚI của con thay đổi tương ứng theo thay đổi của cha. Đáp án C khớp gần nhất với ý đó; bạn nên đối chiếu lại slide gốc.

questions.prompt: When managing multiple scenes, which Unity class provides functionalities for loading and unloading scenes?
options: GameObject
MonoBehaviour
UnityEngine.SceneManagement
Transform
questions.explanation: UnityEngine.SceneManagement (class SceneManager) cung cấp LoadScene/UnloadScene.

questions.prompt: Which of the following allows us to view and edit the properties of the currently selected game object?
options: Inspector window
Overlays
Project window
Status bar
questions.explanation: Inspector window hiển thị và cho phép chỉnh sửa mọi property/component của GameObject đang chọn.

questions.prompt: In Unity C# scripting, what is the purpose of the MonoBehaviour class that all Unity scripts inherit from?
options: To define the main game mechanics and rules.
To provide a base class with methods and properties essential for scripting GameObject behavior in Unity.
To act as the main entry point for Unity applications.
To manage the user interface elements of a Unity game.
questions.explanation: MonoBehaviour là base class cung cấp vòng đời (Awake/Start/Update...) và API cần thiết để viết behavior cho GameObject.

questions.prompt: When implementing mouse dragging with InputAction callbacks, which combination would you use?
options: Use OnMouseDrag(InputAction.CallbackContext context) and check context.performed/context.canceled for start/end drag.
Implement OnMouseDown() and OnMouseUp() methods, and calculate the drag distance in Update()

Register callbacks for OnMouseDown(InputAction.CallbackContext context) and OnMousePosition(InputAction.CallbackContext context), starting the drag on context.performed and tracking the mouse position until the button is released.
Utilize OnLeftClick(InputAction.CallbackContext context) for detecting drag start, and track movement in OnMouseMovement(InputAction.CallbackContext context) until context.canceled is true.
questions.explanation: ⚠️ Các tên hàm trong 4 lựa chọn đều không phải API dựng sẵn của Unity (đều là tên tự đặt minh họa) — đáp án C được chọn vì mô tả ĐẦY ĐỦ nhất luồng: 1 action bắt đầu (performed) + 1 action theo dõi vị trí liên tục tới khi thả nút. Độ tin cậy thấp, nên đối chiếu slide gốc.

questions.prompt: In Unity, how are GameObjects' behavior primarily controlled?
options: Through built-in Components exclusively
Through attached Scripts
Through external plugins
Through visual scripting tools
questions.explanation: ⚠️ Về bản chất hành vi GameObject do Component quyết định (Script chỉ là 1 loại Component), nhưng trong 4 lựa chọn thì 'Through attached Scripts' là đáp án hợp lý nhất theo hướng học lập trình C# của môn — nên đối chiếu lại slide.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the FixedUpdate function in Unity scripts?
options: Initializing variables for script execution
Executing game logic updates once per frame
Handling frame updates for physics-related updates
Executing late updates after all other functions have been called
questions.explanation: FixedUpdate() dùng cho các cập nhật liên quan tới physics (chạy theo bước thời gian cố định, không theo frame rate).

questions.prompt: When is the FixedUpdate() method called in Unity?
options: At a fixed time interval
Once per frame
When the object becomes enabled
After LateUpdate()
questions.explanation: FixedUpdate() được gọi theo khoảng thời gian CỐ ĐỊNH (Time.fixedDeltaTime), độc lập với tốc độ khung hình.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the OnEnable() method in Unity?
options: To perform actions when the object becomes disabled
To initialize variables when the object becomes enabled
To perform actions when the object becomes enabled and active
To update game logic continuously after the object becomes enabled
questions.explanation: OnEnable() được gọi khi object chuyển sang trạng thái enabled và active — đúng theo định nghĩa của Unity docs.

questions.prompt: How do Animation Events enhance interactivity within Unity's Animation System?
options: By allowing animations to loop indefinitely until stopped by a script.
By triggering specific C# script functions at designated points in an animation clip's timeline.
By automatically adjusting the animation's frame rate based on the game's performance.
By enabling the Animator Controller to switch between different animation layers.
questions.explanation: Animation Event cho phép gọi 1 hàm C# cụ thể tại đúng thời điểm (frame) đã đánh dấu trên timeline của animation clip.

questions.prompt: What feature in Unity allows you to create a visual distinction between different button states such as Normal, Highlighted, Pressed, and Disabled?
options: Animation Controller
State Transitions
Canvas Renderer
Scriptable Objects
questions.explanation: ⚠️ Trong Unity, thuộc tính 'Transition' của component Selectable (nút bấm) quản lý các trạng thái Normal/Highlighted/Pressed/Disabled — khớp gần nhất với 'State Transitions'. Nên đối chiếu slide vì tên chính thức là 'Transition' chứ không hẳn 'State Transitions'.

questions.prompt: Which uGUI component is useful for handling scrollable content, particularly for long lists?
options: Slider
Dropdown
Toggle
Scroll View
questions.explanation: Scroll View là component chuẩn để hiển thị nội dung dài, cho phép cuộn.

questions.prompt: What are the bendable parts of a model called?
options: Rigid parts
Texture maps
Bones
Joints
questions.explanation: Bones (xương) trong rig là các phần có thể uốn/cử động của model.

questions.prompt: What is a recommended optimization technique for button assets in Unity?
options: Using Unity's animation system to animate buttons
Scripting custom button behaviors
Assigning functions or methods to buttons for specific actions
Using sprite atlases or sprite sheets to minimize draw calls and improve performance
questions.explanation: Sprite atlas/sprite sheet gộp nhiều ảnh nhỏ lại để giảm số draw call, tối ưu hiệu năng render UI.

questions.prompt: What is an example of a scripted animation transition in Unity?
options: Triggering the transition from idle to walk state when the player presses the forward key
Automatically switching between camera views when the game starts
Making the object rotate continuously without player input
Changing the background music based on the game's progress
questions.explanation: Đây là ví dụ điển hình: input người chơi (nhấn phím) kích hoạt transition giữa 2 animation state (idle → walk).

questions.prompt: What are animation triggers used for in Unity?
options: To manage the camera view during gameplay
To control animations based on button interactions
To handle player movement and physics
To save and load game data
questions.explanation: ⚠️ Trigger parameter trong Animator dùng để kích hoạt transition một lần (thường do input người chơi, có thể qua phím hoặc nút UI) — B là lựa chọn gần đúng nhất trong 4 phương án, nên đối chiếu slide.

questions.prompt: In Unity's physics system, what purpose do colliders serve when developing interactive physics-based puzzles?
options: They act as triggers for starting or stopping animations on game objects.
They define the physical shape of an object for collision detection, enabling objects to interact with each other physically in the game world.
They are used exclusively for rendering realistic lighting effects on game objects.
They control the audio volume level when two objects collide in the game environment.
questions.explanation: Collider định nghĩa hình dạng vật lý dùng để phát hiện va chạm, cho phép các object tương tác vật lý với nhau.

questions.prompt: What is the primary difference between using a Collider as a physical barrier and using it as a Trigger?
options: Colliders can only be used for 3D objects, whereas Triggers are exclusively for 2D objects.
Triggers can physically interact and apply forces to objects, while Colliders cannot.
Colliders act as physical barriers that objects cannot pass through, whereas Triggers do not physically stop objects but instead fire events when an object passes through.
There is no difference; both Colliders and Triggers serve the same purpose in Unity.
questions.explanation: Collider (không tick Is Trigger) chặn vật lý thật sự; Trigger (tick Is Trigger) không chặn mà chỉ bắn sự kiện OnTriggerEnter/Exit.

questions.prompt: Which Collider component in Unity is best suited for objects like balls or other round entities?
options: Box Collider
Sphere Collider
Capsule Collider
Cylinder Collider
questions.explanation: Sphere Collider khớp hình dạng tròn/cầu, phù hợp nhất cho quả bóng.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of Broad-Phase Collision Detection in Unity?
options: To efficiently identify potential collisions among a large number of objects
To determine if potential collision pairs are indeed colliding
To check the precise shapes defined by the colliders
To detect collisions without physically interacting with other objects
questions.explanation: Broad-phase lọc nhanh các cặp object CÓ KHẢ NĂNG va chạm (dùng bounding volume), giảm tải cho bước kiểm tra chi tiết.

questions.prompt: What does Narrow-Phase Collision Detection in Unity involve?
options: A detailed examination of potential collision pairs to determine if they are indeed colliding
Quickly identifying potential collisions among a large number of objects
Detecting collisions without physically interacting with other objects
Checking the precise shapes defined by the colliders
questions.explanation: Narrow-phase kiểm tra CHI TIẾT các cặp đã lọc ở broad-phase để xác nhận có thực sự va chạm hay không.

questions.prompt: What purpose do Layers and Masks serve in Unity Physics?
options: They simulate the force of gravity on objects
They limit the movement of objects with Constraints and Joints
They control which objects interact with each other
They identify when two objects intersect and respond to collisions
questions.explanation: Layer + Collision Matrix (Layer Collision Mask) quyết định layer nào được phép va chạm/tương tác với layer nào.

questions.prompt: Which type of joint in Unity restricts rotation around a single axis, simulating a door hinge or swinging pendulum?
options: Hinge joint
Fixed joint
Spring joint
Configurable joint
questions.explanation: Hinge Joint mô phỏng bản lề — chỉ cho xoay quanh một trục duy nhất, giống cửa hoặc con lắc.

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes events in C#?
options: Objects that hold data and methods that operate on the data
Special methods used for asynchronous programming and store data
Type definitions that specify the methods signature
Delegate that enables one object to notify other objects about actions
questions.explanation: Event trong C# xây trên delegate, cho phép một object thông báo cho các object khác khi có hành động/sự kiện xảy ra.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about delegates in C# is NOT true?
options: Delegates are essentially a reference type that holds the reference to a method.
Delegates can be used to create callback mechanisms.
Delegates cannot be invoked like a regular method.
Delegates allow one object to call methods on another object without knowing its specific type.
questions.explanation: Delegate HOÀN TOÀN có thể được gọi như một hàm bình thường (myDelegate()) — nên phát biểu 'không thể gọi như hàm thường' là SAI, đây là đáp án cần chọn cho câu hỏi 'NOT true'.

questions.prompt: What is the role of the Animator Component in Unity?
options: To store animation data, including keyframes, curves, and events
To organize animation states and transitions based on the assigned Animator Controller
To control animation playback based on the assigned Animator Controller
To create audio effects for animations based on the assigned Animator Controller
questions.explanation: Animator Component (gắn trên GameObject) điều khiển việc PHÁT animation dựa theo Animator Controller được gán — khác với Controller (vốn tổ chức state/transition).

questions.prompt: Where are UI elements placed in Unity?
options: On a Sprite folder
In a Scene Manager
On a Canvas component
In a Transform component
questions.explanation: Mọi UI element (uGUI) đều phải nằm trong một Canvas component để được render.
